plan.title: SRC-AWD-007 — Award L1 vendor and reject blank approval remark

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with two bids directly on Master QCS.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled as required by the case configuration.
Open the awarding screen for the closed two-bid event.
Allocate all 10 requested units on the only line to the L1 vendor, Vendor B.
Verify one line is fully selected, exactly one of two vendors is awarded, and the proposal value is 10 × 90 = 900.
Create the proposal from the completed allocation.
Verify the proposal identifies Vendor B as the proposed vendor.
Verify the proposal shows the expected total value of 900.
Complete any mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Submit the proposal so it can enter approval.
Verify the submitted proposal is pending approval before the approver-specific check.
